_instructions: Optional wording for images in public/art and public/photography. Key each entry by the exact filename. Anything you leave out still appears on the page, captioned from its filename. 'alt' is what a screen reader announces, so describe what is in the image; 'caption' is the line shown underneath.

01-night-traffic-in-fog.jpg.title: Night Traffic in Fog
01-night-traffic-in-fog.jpg.alt: A city street at night swallowed by fog, with traffic lights glowing green and red through the haze and their reflections smeared across the wet asphalt.
01-night-traffic-in-fog.jpg.caption: The fog eats the avenue two blocks out.

02-rain-blurred-canyon.jpg.title: Rain-Blurred Canyon
02-rain-blurred-canyon.jpg.alt: A rain-soaked street between tall buildings seen from inside a car, headlights and red tail lights streaked into long reflections on the wet road.
02-rain-blurred-canyon.jpg.caption: Nothing is in focus and that is the point.

03-pink-neon-wet-street.jpg.title: Pink Neon, Wet Street
03-pink-neon-wet-street.jpg.alt: A midtown street at night with a pink and red neon sign glowing over the pavement, tall buildings closing in above and the wet road carrying the colour back.

04-castle-in-green-light.jpg.title: Castle in Green Light
04-castle-in-green-light.jpg.alt: A crenellated red-brick building lit with bright green light along every edge at night, bare winter trees standing in front of it and the green glow receding down the wet street.
04-castle-in-green-light.jpg.caption: Snow on the ground, green on the walls.

05-looking-up-into-fog.jpg.title: Looking Up Into Fog
05-looking-up-into-fog.jpg.alt: A steep upward view of city skyscrapers at night, purple and magenta signage glowing on the facades and the tops of the towers disappearing into low cloud.

06-green-light-yellow-cab.jpg.title: Green Light, Yellow Cab
06-green-light-yellow-cab.jpg.alt: A narrow night street walled in by towers with tall green light panels down one side, a yellow taxi and dark cars stopped in the lane ahead on the wet road.

07-neon-and-rain.jpg.title: Neon and Rain
07-neon-and-rain.jpg.alt: A night street lined with green vertical neon over a yellow taxi and traffic, raindrops beaded across the lens and the wet road doubling every light.
07-neon-and-rain.jpg.caption: Rain on the lens, green down the block.

08-screening-time.jpg.title: Screening Time
08-screening-time.jpg.alt: A wet night street beneath a tall billboard reading Screening Time, a yellow Sienna taxi and dark cars stopped ahead, and a rain-covered side mirror in the foreground.

09-fire-escape-and-citi-bikes.jpg.title: Fire Escape and Citi Bikes
09-fire-escape-and-citi-bikes.jpg.alt: A brick tenement at night with black fire escapes and window air conditioners above a warmly lit restaurant awning, blue Citi Bikes docked along the wet sidewalk in front.

10-red-script-neon.jpg.title: Red Script Neon
10-red-script-neon.jpg.alt: A red neon sign in flowing script mounted on a dark brick wall, with warm pendant bulbs hanging beside it in the shadows.

11-walls-of-photographs.jpg.title: Walls of Photographs
11-walls-of-photographs.jpg.alt: The interior of a warmly lit bar whose brick walls are papered edge to edge with old photographs above dark banquette seating.

12-red-carpet-entrance.jpg.title: Red Carpet Entrance
12-red-carpet-entrance.jpg.alt: A storefront at night with a red neon sign and a blue-lit awning, a red mat on the pavement and the interior glowing behind the glass.

13-golden-arches-at-night.jpg.title: Golden Arches at Night
13-golden-arches-at-night.jpg.alt: A McDonald's storefront on a city street at night, its yellow arches lit over the entrance, a car and a pedestrian passing in front.

14-corner-store-in-snow.jpg.title: Corner Store in Snow
14-corner-store-in-snow.jpg.alt: A corner storefront at night glowing pink and purple onto a snowy street, with parked cars along the kerb and slush on the ground.

15-snow-along-the-park-fence.jpg.title: Snow Along the Park Fence
15-snow-along-the-park-fence.jpg.alt: A snowy city street running beside a fenced park, bare trees behind the fence and tall buildings rising beyond, seen on a flat winter afternoon.

16-blue-hour-in-the-snow.jpg.title: Blue Hour in the Snow
16-blue-hour-in-the-snow.jpg.alt: A park edge at dusk with cars parked along the fence, snow banked over the pavement and the wet street holding the last of the blue light.

17-tire-tracks-at-dusk.jpg.title: Tire Tracks at Dusk
17-tire-tracks-at-dusk.jpg.alt: A snow-covered residential street at dusk, bare trees arching overhead and tire tracks cut through the slush past dark townhouses.

18-footprints-across-the-field.jpg.title: Footprints Across the Field
18-footprints-across-the-field.jpg.alt: An open snow-covered park under a flat grey sky, a lone bare tree at the far side and lines of footprints crossing the untouched snow.
18-footprints-across-the-field.jpg.caption: Someone walked here before us.

19-lamplight-on-wet-snow.jpg.title: Lamplight on Wet Snow
19-lamplight-on-wet-snow.jpg.alt: A park path in snow at dusk, the lit windows of townhouses and the glow of street lamps reflected in the wet patches of the path.

20-benches-under-snow.jpg.title: Benches Under Snow
20-benches-under-snow.jpg.alt: A row of park benches seen from behind in a snowy park, bare trees and grey sky beyond and footprints trodden into the path.

21-quiet-street-in-snow.jpg.title: Quiet Street in Snow
21-quiet-street-in-snow.jpg.alt: A quiet snow-covered street lined with brick townhouses, bare trees above and tire tracks running away into the falling light.

22-the-long-path.jpg.title: The Long Path
22-the-long-path.jpg.alt: A snow-covered park path with an empty black bench and a lamp post on the left, bare trees and historic low buildings behind.

23-snowfield.jpg.title: Snowfield
23-snowfield.jpg.alt: A wide empty field of snow under a grey winter sky with bare trees along the far edge and trails of footprints leading across it.

24-cast-iron-corner.jpg.title: Cast Iron Corner
24-cast-iron-corner.jpg.alt: A tall cast-iron corner building in the city on a clear blue day, its ornate facade in sun, with cars parked at the kerb and a pedestrian carrying a red bag across the crossing.

25-the-tall-one.jpg.title: The Tall One
25-the-tall-one.jpg.alt: A skyscraper seen from the pavement, leaning up out of frame against a pale hazy sky, with a smaller light-coloured block in front of it.

26-red-jacket.jpg.title: Red Jacket
26-red-jacket.jpg.alt: The glass entrance of a large building on a bright day, pedestrians crossing the pavement in front, one of them in a red jacket.

27-everyone-is-going-somewhere.jpg.title: Everyone Is Going Somewhere
27-everyone-is-going-somewhere.jpg.alt: A crowded city pavement in daylight, people walking in both directions between tall buildings and traffic stopped at the kerb.

28-hydrant-and-blue-sky.jpg.title: Hydrant and Blue Sky
28-hydrant-and-blue-sky.jpg.alt: A white fire hydrant on a city corner under a hard blue sky, with low brick buildings, parked cars and bare branches behind it.

29-the-city-across-the-water.jpg.title: The City Across the Water
29-the-city-across-the-water.jpg.alt: A downtown skyline seen across open water on an overcast day, with a strip of dry grass in the foreground and the towers greyed by cloud.

30-grey-water-grey-skyline.jpg.title: Grey Water, Grey Skyline
30-grey-water-grey-skyline.jpg.alt: The same downtown skyline from the far shore under heavy grey cloud, the water flat and the buildings almost the same tone as the sky.

31-arches-at-sunset.jpg.title: Arches at Sunset
31-arches-at-sunset.jpg.alt: The McDonald's arches on a tall sign against a sky burnt orange and pink at sunset, a silver car and an empty car park below.

32-the-chair-by-the-table.jpg.title: The Chair by the Table
32-the-chair-by-the-table.jpg.alt: A black, tan and white dog with speckled chest and folded ears sitting on a wooden spindle-back chair beside a table covered in a fruit-patterned oilcloth, looking straight at the camera.
32-the-chair-by-the-table.jpg.caption: He knows exactly where the food is.

33-sofa-arm-puppy.jpg.title: Sofa Arm Puppy
33-sofa-arm-puppy.jpg.alt: A black, white and tan puppy resting its chin on the arm of a brown sofa, one white paw tucked under its muzzle and its eyes cast down.

34-puppy-and-the-green-toy.jpg.title: Puppy and the Green Toy
34-puppy-and-the-green-toy.jpg.alt: A puppy asleep on a soft grey cushion, curled around a bright green plush toy and holding it with one white paw.

35-head-down.jpg.title: Head Down
35-head-down.jpg.alt: A close crop of a black, tan and white dog's head tilted down, its nose and eyelashes filling the frame above pale wooden boards.

36-through-the-glass-door.jpg.title: Through the Glass Door
36-through-the-glass-door.jpg.alt: A large white dog with brown patches over its eyes and muzzle standing on grass behind glass, with the reflection of a person in dark clothing visible across the door.

37-monkey-with-a-scarf.jpg.title: Monkey With a Scarf
37-monkey-with-a-scarf.jpg.alt: A black, tan and white dog leaning in beside a hand holding a small plush monkey dressed in a red knitted scarf.

38-white-room.jpg.title: White Room
38-white-room.jpg.alt: A tight crop of a black, tan and white dog's head turned to the side, photographed against a plain white background.

39-empty-bowl.jpg.title: Empty Bowl
39-empty-bowl.jpg.alt: A dog's head down inside a metal bowl on a wooden floor, the bowl already empty, with its speckled white chest and one folded ear visible.

40-lollipop-inspection.jpg.title: Lollipop Inspection
40-lollipop-inspection.jpg.alt: A dog leaning forward to sniff a rainbow-swirled lollipop held out to it on a stick, indoors on a dark floor.

41-black-cat-indoors.jpg.title: Black Cat, Indoors
41-black-cat-indoors.jpg.alt: A black cat sitting upright on a wooden floor indoors, yellow eyes on the camera, with snow visible through the window behind it.

42-black-cat-on-the-floor.jpg.title: Black Cat on the Floor
42-black-cat-on-the-floor.jpg.alt: A black cat crossing a wooden floor towards the camera, passing a brass and copper contraption in warm indoor light.

43-lets-take-a-break-from-watching.jpg.title: Let's Take a Break From Watching
43-lets-take-a-break-from-watching.jpg.alt: Pencil drawings pinned to a wooden board: animated popcorn, drink and candy boxes walking along, lettered with the words Let's take a break from watching movies at home and go see a movie!

44-farm-fresh-ingredients.jpg.title: Farm Fresh Ingredients
44-farm-fresh-ingredients.jpg.alt: A white brick wall inside a restaurant with a blue neon sign of a smiling panda face ringed by the words 100% Farm Fresh Ingredients, white orchids and small potted plants on a shelf below.

45-departure-gate-panda.jpg.title: Departure Gate Panda
45-departure-gate-panda.jpg.alt: A fluffy pink and white panda plush with rosy cheeks and a sunflower bib, its tag still on, propped against a black bag strapped to a suitcase in an airport departure lounge.

46-doll-at-the-shore.jpg.title: Doll at the Shore
46-doll-at-the-shore.jpg.alt: A hand holding up a small doll with a brown fuzzy face and a pink floral silk dress, against a pebbled shore, calm water and a blue sky streaked with cloud.

47-popcorn-before-the-film.jpg.title: Popcorn Before the Film
47-popcorn-before-the-film.jpg.alt: A bag of popcorn and a drink on a narrow table in a dark cinema, the only light coming from the screen ahead.

48-hippo-and-hare.jpg.title: Hippo and Hare
48-hippo-and-hare.jpg.alt: A bronze sculpture of a hippopotamus with its mouth wide open seated at a cafe table opposite a hare in a dress, under the white ribs and red glow of a modern building.
